::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** May 23. 1867  
**Manuscript:** Copy outletter book British Library Add MSS.55387 (1) P. 209
:::

Dear Miss Yonge	.
The presentation copies will be attended to. The [book](cmy_books/cmybook_63.qmd) however is hardly yet in the binders hands. Books like 'long-tailed birds of Paradise' will not light at the end.

[I](people/person_939.qmd) am glad that the Danvers name seems connected with [Mr Peabody](people/person_1990.qmd). We should send him a copy.

The 62 pages of your law[?] makes 92 of the [Book of Worthies](cmy_books/cmybook_80.qmd)[^1] (I am afraid I [*illegible*]  I like our first title best) so we would like about ms 250 pages, more or less, additional for the volume.

I think your <u>[disciples of St John](cmy_books/cmybook_72.qmd)</u> should be excellent. [Miss Martin](people/person_971.qmd) will write you in a day or two.

Yours very faithfully
A. Macmillan

---

[^1]: The sense of this is presumably 'your large law paper'.
